title: Spicy Cod Fritters
description: A flavorful Mexican dish with crispy cod fritters, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Cut the cod into small pieces and season with salt and cayenne pepper.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and a pinch of salt.
4. Dip each piece of cod into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
5. Dip the floured cod into the panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
6. Fry the cod fritters in the hot oil for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
8. Serve the fritters hot with your favorite Mexican toppings, such as salsa, guacamole, and sour cream.
